label: Materials
hint: the materials tab of plant lab

label: Grid layout
hint: switching to one grid copies the boxes into it

label: Brush color
hint: the wheel is hue around, saturation out from the middle

label: Role
hint: a label only; species pick boxes per material slot

label: Shading
hint: the shading tab of plant lab

label: Mid tone
hint: tone before any shading is applied

label: Center darker
hint: pixels deep inside a shape

label: Curve start
hint: below this the response is flat at 0

label: Curve end
hint: above this the response is flat at 1

label: Curve gamma
hint: below 1 reaches the plateau sooner

label: Preview core depth (px)
hint: depth at which a shape reads as fully core

label: Species
hint: the species tab of plant lab

label: Spawn rate
hint: attempts per simulation second

label: Spread rate
hint: offspring per parent per second

label: Growth rate
hint: segments per simulation second

label: Shrivel (s)
hint: how long a plant takes to dry out and come apart once it is past its age

label: Phototropism
hint: pull of tips back toward vertical

label: Footprint radius (cells)
hint: clamped by the size class ceiling

label: Adaptive core depth
hint: off keeps thin parts light, on lets every shape use the full ramp

label: World
hint: the world tab of plant lab

label: Columns (x)
hint: cells across the area

label: Rows (depth)
hint: cells from the far edge to the near edge

label: Cell depth (px)
hint: screen height of one row; below the cell width it foreshortens the ground

label: Sky height (px)
hint: room above the far row for tall plants

label: Distance haze
hint: tone lift applied to far rows, in ramp steps

label: Max footprint radius (cells)
hint: ceiling on the perimeter a plant may claim

label: Min spacing (cells)
hint: gap enforced between two items of this class

label: Seed
hint: applied on restart

label: Redraws per frame
hint: plants rasterized per frame; lower keeps the view responsive

label: Draw
hint: the draw tab of sprite editor

label: Brush color
hint: the wheel is hue around, saturation out from the middle

label: Mirror X
hint: paints the same pixel on both sides

label: Sheet
hint: the sheet tab of sprite editor

label: Frame width
hint: art keeps its place; new room is empty

label: Rate
hint: frames per second, for playing it back and for a clip made from this sheet

label: One file per frame too
hint: as well as the strip, not instead of it

label: Keep a copy
hint: every save copies the project's sheets in here

label: Land
hint: the land tab of settlement

label: Columns (x)
hint: cells across the map

label: Cell width (px)
hint: everything drawn is sized from this

label: Cell depth (px)
hint: lower values tilt the ground toward the viewer

label: Seed
hint: terrain, deposits, settlers and everything they do

label: Feature size
hint: cells per noise feature; larger means broader hills and lakes

label: Warp
hint: bends the coastlines out of the noise grid

label: Fertility
hint: how much the damp ground feeds a farm

label: Wild growth
hint: how lush the map is: scales seeding and how many plants the land carries

label: Wilderness warmup (s)
hint: growth simulated before the settlers arrive

label: Springs per 10000 cells
hint: a larger map gets more rivers rather than longer ones

label: Channel width at the mouth
hint: in cells; the head is always one

label: Meander
hint: how far the course is pushed off the fall line

label: Shortest river kept
hint: a trickle shorter than this is thrown away

label: Bank fertility
hint: how much the damp ground either side feeds a farm

label: Day and night
hint: tints the map with the hour and lights the windows

label: Footpaths
hint: cells that get walked over wear into a path

label: River current
hint: ripples along the flow, baked into the ground

label: Draw only what is on screen
hint: off is slower and only useful when something looks wrong at the edge

label: Detail threshold (zoom)
hint: zoom below this and the drawing starts shedding detail: first the flourishes, then the sprites, then everything but the shapes

label: Foliage over people
hint: somebody walking behind a bush is behind it; the other two keep them findable

label: People
hint: the people tab of settlement

label: Settlers
hint: applied on the next restart

label: Arrive with a storehouse
hint: off means the first thing they do is build one

label: Start over if everyone dies
hint: off by default: a settlement dying out is usually the thing worth looking at

label: Wait before starting over (s)
hint: settlement time, so a paused world never counts down

label: Draw settlers from dropped images
hint: off keeps every sheet and goes back to the generated settler

label: Day length (s)
hint: simulated seconds in one day

label: Work starts
hint: fraction of the day

label: Walking speed
hint: cells per second

label: Path speed bonus
hint: how much a worn path helps

label: Swimming speed
hint: against walking speed, once somebody is in the water

label: Cost of a swim
hint: how much dearer a step into water is than one onto ground: high enough and a river is only ever walked round

label: Carry capacity
hint: one load; the rest is left where it fell

label: Work rate
hint: global multiplier on every kind of work

label: Laborer share
hint: adults kept out of workplaces to haul and build

label: Eats at
hint: hunger level that sends someone to the store

label: Meal size
hint: food units per meal

label: Rests per second
hint: a bed under a roof is worth a third again

label: Years per day
hint: how fast people age

label: Marries from (years)
hint: only couples have children

label: Births per couple per day
hint: thinned by food in store and by housing

label: Sickness per day
hint: a well nearby cuts this, and so does being hardy

label: Dead kept on file
hint: the register holds a slot for everyone ever born; this is where it stops growing

label: Settlers keep track of each other
Meeting pass (s)
hint: simulated seconds between passes over who is standing near whom

label: People remembered
hint: the faintest bonds are forgotten first; family never is

label: Warmth per meeting
hint: how far one meeting moves a bond toward what the two make of each other

label: Friendship at
hint: and a feud at its negative

label: Worth of good company
hint: how much friends nearby lift contentment

label: Courtship weight
hint: how much affinity decides between two matches of a like age; it has no say across a generation

label: Meetings per pass
hint: what bounds the cost of a crowd

label: Kept from a wage
hint: the rest returns to the treasury

label: A night at an inn
hint: what somebody with no roof pays for a bed and a meal

label: Harvest rate
hint: plant mass cut per second

label: Farming rate
hint: multiplied by the fertility under the fields

label: Cleared ground yield
hint: share of a plant recovered when a building is raised over it

label: Plant index rebuild (s)
hint: how often the coarse map of what is growing where is refreshed

label: Build
hint: the build tab of settlement

label: Plan buildings automatically
hint: off leaves every building to the Build buttons below

label: Sites at once
hint: how many buildings may be under construction

label: Spacing (cells)
hint: gap kept between buildings

label: Sprawl (cells)
hint: how far from the center a site may be

label: Housing headroom
hint: empty beds kept ahead of the population

label: Upgrade price scale
hint: multiplies the coin an owner has to put up

label: Salvage from the old house
hint: share of the old materials that count toward the new

label: Homes rebuilt at once
hint: a rebuild takes its beds out of the housing stock, and only starts when the household has somewhere else to sleep

label: Send out expeditions
hint: a crowded, well stocked town founds another one

label: Settlers in a party
hint: families follow them

label: Supplies carried out
hint: of each founding resource

label: People before walling
hint: a village that walls itself spends everything on the wall and then starves inside it

label: Ring clearance (cells)
hint: gap kept between the outermost building and the wall

label: Ways through
hint: gates are drawn to the busiest cells of the ring and spread apart

label: Wall pieces at once
hint: counted apart from the sites above, or a ring would stop the town building anything else

label: Stall price scale
hint: multiplies the coin a keeper has to put up

label: Keeper's margin
hint: what a keeper adds to the town price, times how practised they are

label: Customers per stall
hint: a counter takes its keeper out of every other trade

label: Economy
hint: the economy tab of settlement

label: Price elasticity
hint: how hard scarcity moves a price

label: Hoard limit
hint: stock above this multiple of the target is left on the ground

label: Wage per work second
hint: paid only once a market stands

label: Hold
hint: units of cargo

label: Speed
hint: cells per second

label: Crew
hint: dock workers who sail with it

label: Port margin
hint: what the far market takes on both halves

label: Days between visits
hint: in simulated seconds

label: Tech
hint: the tech tab of settlement

label: Cost scale
hint: multiplies every tech cost

label: Insight per person per second
hint: what a settlement works out without a school

label: Need bias
hint: how strongly automatic research chases what the settlement is short of

label: Undo
hint: step back through changes

label: Redo
hint: step forward again

label: Hide menu
hint: fold the side menu away and hand its width to the world

label: Fullscreen
hint: show just the world, no menus

label: New
hint: start an empty project

label: Export
hint: save the project to a file

label: Import
hint: load a project from a file

label: Reset all
hint: throw everything away and start over

label: Text size
hint: how large every label and control is drawn

label: Meaning
hint: match menus on what they mean, not only how they are spelled
